environment_probe_permissions: prepare.py environment probe ran under workspace sandbox; the long batch runs in the approved local socket/Chromium context. The observed NVIDIA error is evidence of that probe result, not proof that the entire host GPU driver is broken. No extra GPU probe is added.
phase12_external_gate: Frozen child env has no ISAAC_SIM_ROOT or ROS_DISTRO; original detect_environment therefore cannot classify it ISAAC_READY or ROS2_READY even if device visibility differs. External planner providers are source-pinned BLOCKED_BY_ENV branches.
source_before_after: Each stage source-before.json stores the difference against the shared immutable runtime-source-pins.json. result.json source_drift stores the post-run difference after checking every same pin. No separate full source-after.json is produced; empty lists mean all pinned bytes matched at that observation. Raw exit is retained before post-run audit and report parsing.
source_scope_boundary: New report/runtime artifacts are outside the current runtime-source pinset and are excluded by the official product source-hash algorithm. Final official source hash and tracked development-source diff will be recorded independently.
status_page_boundary: docs/current_authoritative_status.md retains the Nov 2 snapshot; R413 final development report will explicitly reconcile it with R412 and actual R413 outcomes. This run does not rewrite older status or raw records.
